quiz.question_id: Jika struct besar dikirim ke fungsi tanpa pointer, apa yang terjadi?
quiz.question_en: If a large struct is passed to a function without a pointer, what happens?
options_id: Fungsi menerima referensi ke struct asli
Seluruh struct disalin ke parameter fungsi
Program panic karena struct terlalu besar
options_en: The function receives a reference to the original struct
The entire struct is copied into the function parameter
The program panics because the struct is too large
Only the first field is copied

quiz.question_id: Apa yang dimaksud dengan 'escape analysis' di Go?
quiz.question_en: What does 'escape analysis' mean in Go?
options_id: Proses compiler menentukan apakah variabel harus di stack atau heap
options_en: Compiler process determining whether a variable should be on stack or heap
A technique to avoid garbage collection

quiz.question_id: Kapan sebaiknya menggunakan value semantics daripada pointer semantics?
quiz.question_en: When should you use value semantics instead of pointer semantics?
options_id: Selalu gunakan pointer untuk performa terbaik
Untuk data kecil, immutable, atau ketika salinan independen diinginkan
Hanya untuk tipe built-in seperti int dan string
Ketika struct memiliki lebih dari 5 field
options_en: Always use pointers for best performance
For small, immutable data, or when independent copies are desired
Only for built-in types like int and string
When a struct has more than 5 fields
